reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getScheduledAmount and computes the tolerance with the existing getApproxNumberThreshold used by rule matching, rather than re-deriving 7.5%.

duplication.why: The approximate rule exists only inside getScheduledAmount; callers just pass their operator.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules where the range rule lives, and each consumer only supplies its own op field.

scope.why: Focused on the amount rule and its callers; turning the positional inverse flag into an options object is a small interface reshape beyond the strict need, though no caller used the positional flag.

maintainability.why: One definition for the worst-case amount; the op is optional, so a future caller that forgets it silently gets the exact value for approximate amounts.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every planning/display caller goes through getScheduledAmount with its op.

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount, called with the op by the server (preview, posting, actions sync, forecast, template, API model) and client (balance, tables, mobile lists) paths.
